cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's my inspection pass. I've signed in the box you signed. Log my arrival and open the storeroom, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I signed as a specimen for the training pack. Your manager still has to authorize the visit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, specimen checked. Put my start time underneath; the manager signs the completed inspection.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call her before I unlock anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then record the inspection as suspended for your call. Put your name beside the delay so she knows whom to ask.

reason: Copy specimen signing as authorization, then turn B direct verification into an attributed procedural delay.
